content: Project health: at risk. The first seven phases are essentially complete, but Integration & testing is slipping: a cluster of overdue tasks there holds up most of the release phase.
highlights: Clear the overdue integration tasks before starting new frontend work.
Give an owner to the unassigned tasks due next week.
risks: Several overdue tasks sit on the path to the final release.
Three members hold most of the open work; the load is uneven.
